Forcing s = 1 in the researcher's own proxy gives chi2 = 3.3e9. This is the repo's own G8 v2 lemma (g8_sm_pati_salam_flavour_nogo_v20: 'one light G3221 bidoublet with a G3221-equivariant 10/126bar composition forces s = 1 (CKM = 1) for any tan beta; escapes: two light bidoublets, a (15,1,3) component, ...'). The fit's best point needs s = 0.48 e^{0.11 i}; the literature basin (Mummidi-Patel 2109.04050, LIT-snippet) has r = 77.4, s = 0.314-0.028i with h_d mainly from 126bar. Hence T3 (two light bidoublets) is NECESSARY, contrary to 'T3 not required by the counting'
